posts.title: LLM told me to do so - navigating my career in the age of AI
posts.description: Something that has been bothering me for a while and I’d really like to put it in writing. I believe that LLM based AI is going to negatively impact an ability for a person to become an expert at anything. As an effect of that, a negative feedback loop is going to form where AI will become dumber and dumber. You can’t have LLM learn more and yet destroy the whole incentive for learning anything.
